Attached: 1 image

Round 4 of me trying to switch to #HomeAssistant from #AppleHome.

This time it's serious - #Claude helped me to run HomeAssistant in #Docker on #ArduinoUnoQ since this board has great balance of power and energy efficiency.

Then I tried to connect all my stuff to my new home but my #DIY #AirQuality Monitor I made years ago on #ArduinoNanoMatter won't connect since it needs #Thread. 

So I moved it to #ArduinoNanoESP32 I have laying around and will use it with ESPHome for better HA integration.
